name: FDNRecentlyViewed.findFDNRecentlyViewed
query: SELECT new com.fluig.foundation.recentlyviewed.entity.FDNRecentlyViewed( rv.tenantId, rv.login, MAX(rv.datAccess), rv.description, rv.type, rv.page, rv.processInstanceId, rv.documentId) FROM FDNRecentlyViewed rv WHERE rv.tenantId = :tenantId AND rv.login = :login AND (rv.page IS NULL OR rv.page NOT IN(:excludedPages)) GROUP BY rv.login, rv.tenantId, rv.description, rv.type, rv.page, rv.processInstanceId, rv.documentId ORDER BY MAX(rv.datAccess) DESC
